rules.description: Stateless, accessible primitives (shadcn-style on Radix UI). Style with Tailwind using design tokens from globals.css. No business logic.
Dashboard components. Read tenant data only via useWorkspaceData(); mutate via useAppStore actions. Gate controls with useCan().
Landing page sections. Fixed navy palette (theme-independent). Use Reveal/Stagger from marketing/motion.tsx; animate transform/opacity only.
Thin route files. Compose components; client pages that read search params wrap content in <Suspense>.
Zod schemas shared by forms (React Hook Form + zodResolver). The API will reuse them; never rely on them as the only control.
Zustand stores. Every action maps to an endpoint in src/lib/api/contract.ts and is scoped to activeWorkspaceId.
Deterministic, clearly fictional demo data only. Never real companies, people or statistics.
Use the validated --chart-1..5 palette in fixed order, one y-axis per chart, legend for 2+ series, tooltips on every chart.

conventions.naming: kebab-case for files, PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for constants.
conventions.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with tokens defined in src/app/globals.css (light + dark). No CSS Modules.
conventions.state: Zustand for app data (demo persistence), local state for UI; React Query or similar once the API exists.
conventions.security: No secrets in code; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML; validate redirects with safeNext(); sanitize CSV exports.
conventions.assets: Inline SVG for illustrations; no remote images.
